name: io.github.Servosity/hook-security-mcp
title: Hook Security MCP
description: Hook Security phishing and training data for MSPs: click rates, overdue training, QBR numbers.

environmentVariables.name: HOOK_SECURITY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Hook API key, created by an admin under Settings > API keys.

environmentVariables.name: HOOK_SECURITY_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional: override the User-Agent the CLI sends.

environmentVariables.name: HOOK_SECURITY_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: set to 1 to remove the tools that write local files. No tool can change Hook either way.

environmentVariables.name: HOOK_SECURITY_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token callers must present when the server runs with --transport http; not used by stdio.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Not enforced by this connector; leave unset. It does not limit access.

environmentVariables.name: HOOK_SECURITY_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional: set to 1 to keep no local copy of Hook data (no response cache, sync refused).
